sim.dynamics: MuJoCo position servos, 25 x 2 ms physics substeps per action

task.name: reach
task.definition: move the end effector to a target point; success = within success radius for consecutive steps

ee_error_base_m.definition: target - EE position, rotated into the base frame

action_space.definition: a_f = 0.5 a_f + 0.5 a; q_ref += a_f * step_scale (per control step); q_ref clipped to range; position servo tracks q_ref

electrodes.layout: 220 x 120 electrodes, 17.5 um pitch (index = row*220 + col). Each sim channel = one region of 4x4 HD electrodes (16 recording electrodes, 1 stimulation electrode), 8x8 regions at 210 um pitch centred on the array -> 1024 routed recording electrodes

timing.notes: One control step = one culture trial. In simulation the robot is paused while the culture computes; on hardware use step-and-hold (robot holds q_ref during the trial and executes one control_dt step per decoded action). Spike-to-action latency adds to the loop period; keep it below max_end_to_end_latency_ms.

target.name: MaxWell Biosystems MaxOne / MaxTwo HD-MEA
target.layout: 220 x 120 electrodes, 17.5 um pitch (index = row*220 + col). Each sim channel = one region of 4x4 HD electrodes (16 recording electrodes, 1 stimulation electrode), 8x8 regions at 210 um pitch centred on the array -> 1024 routed recording electrodes
target.sdk: maxlab Python API (MaxLab Live) for configuration/routing/stimulation sequences; low-latency closed loop via the MaxLab Live real-time (C++) spike stream

provenance.culture_model: neurorover.culture.core.Culture: Izhikevich RS/FS (80/20), 1024 neurons, 16 per electrode, 1 ms steps, distance-dependent recurrent synapses + plastic sensory->motor projection

sim_reference.note: sim-faithful: identical actions to the original sim controller (verified); the runtime's robot soft limits are off for this recording only

transferable: decoder STRUCTURE (weights only as an initial guess)
not_transferable: synaptic weights / connectivity of the simulated culture
the trained performance itself -- a living culture starts untrained
stimulation amplitudes in physical units (sim has none; set by calibration)
warnings: simulated weights are not transferable; run calibration on the living culture first
stimulation parameters are conservative defaults: must be validated against vendor/lab limits
